schwendicke2015radiographic.used_finding: 117 studies; detection of any kind (i.e. also initial) lesions had low sensitivities (0.24 to 0.42) but moderate to high specificities (0.70 to 0.97); for dentine lesions sensitivities 0.36 (proximal) to 0.56 (occlusal). The abstract labels the first range 'pooled DOR', an evident slip: it is the sensitivity range.

hennig2023frequency.used_finding: 9,680 extraoral dental radiographs of patients up to 18 years, one university department, 2002-2020: 78% were orthopantomograms; effective dose 7 uSv for an OPG.
